notes.title: TrueScale 1.014 - Material Editing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30967944/05b708c902b3930c679cd8ec399f974b1ae15f2f.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! We are pleased to introduce TrueScale’s brand new patch!
 
We’ve added a new and very useful feature: Material Editing. You can browse through different materials and fabrics and apply them to most of the objects. This option can help you experiment with different textures, patterns and surfaces. It may come in handy when choosing new home accessories and polishing off your own design. This feature will give you more flexibility and more freedom in designing your living room or office. Have fun! You’re welcome to share your designs with us on social media. 

Just enter EDIT mode by pressing the Menu button while your selected object is highlighted.

[h1]Version 1.014[/h1]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] implemented Material Editing tool
[*] added tooltips on buttons
[*] added preview for wall and floor materials
[*] added preview for windows and doors
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] changed some 3D models to make them editable
[*] added some new UI sounds
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed the bug when red highlight persisted on an object even if not longer in contact with controllers rear end
[*] fixed issue when drawing a floor won't disable itself while changing tabs
[*] other minor bug fixes
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30967944/6d14301fec61c0e692dab2a0ae504f9ffc084cd7.png[/img]

notes.title: TrueScale 1.013 Patch Notes - Objects Rescaling
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30967944/3e0f9f58244e17e071e67b66b149a55f5e4917bb.gif[/img]

Hey Everyone!

We take community feedback seriously and all your opinions and suggestions help us make our products better and more functional. Since many of you were asking for an option to scale the size of furniture units, we are adding this feature with this new patch. Users can now adjust the size of all windows, doors and furniture pieces with a new measurement tool. The new feature adds more functionality to the app making your design more accurate.                                                                                    
To adjust the size of your selected object, simply click on it with your controller and press the Menu button (B button on Oculus) to enter Edit Mode. Now, you can easily adjust the size by dragging the object accordingly. You will see the exact size of your object on the dimension scale next to it. 


[h1]Version 1.013[/h1]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Edit Mode, press the Menu button while touching an object to enter Edit mode
[*] Added Rescale option, while in Edit Mode drag object sides to change its size
[*] Added Dimension Scale to objects while in Edit Mode
[*] Added a highlight effect to interactive objects
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] deleting kitchen countertop doesn t disable save feature now
[*] user cannot see the skybox through the floor now
[*] adjusted several furniture models
[/list]

https://youtu.be/iLt-gDevmZs

UPDATE: Hot fix patch 1.0131 is now live, fixing some issues caused by 1.013 patch

notes.title: True Scale 1.010 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We as a development team would like to thank, all of you who decided to help us to create a better product by joining our Early Access. Your opinion and feedback are very valuable to us and we read every single comment and opinion in order to make our software better.

Today we launch our first patch fixing some of the issues you reported:


[h1] Version 1.010[/h1]
    [b] Features:[/b]
[list]
         [*]Added autodetection if user is using imperial or metric units
         [*]Added snap grid auto adjustment, when users stand far from the board the snapping grid increases to eliminate shaky hand effect and lowers as users get closer to the board.
[/list]
    [b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
         [*]Changed Sideboard UI units and reset table buttons
         [*]Slightlty improved main room graphics
[/list]
    [b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[list]
        [*]next page arrow didn't t appear on wall textures and floor textures tab
        [*]deleting window or door on a floorplan left an empty hole in a wall
        [*]first saves appeared to height so they cover photos appeared cut
        [*]when selected change floor texture, the pointer froze when changed to different mode
[/list]
